## Complete Report: RPC Handlers That Transitively Cause Outbound HTTP Requests to User-Configured URLs

### Project Overview

This is **Memos** (`github.com/usememos/memos`), a self-hosted note-taking application written in Go. It uses **ConnectRPC** (and gRPC-Gateway) for its API layer. All RPC handler methods live on the `APIV1Service` struct in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/`. The `ConnectServiceHandler` in `connect_handler.go` wraps `APIV1Service` and delegates every call to it.

---

### Outbound HTTP Request Mechanisms (the "sinks")

There are **four distinct mechanisms** that make outbound network requests to user-configured URLs:

#### 1. Webhook Dispatch (HTTP POST to user-configured webhook URLs)
- **Convergence point**: `webhook.Post()` and `webhook.PostAsync()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go`
- `Post()` (line 120) makes an `http.Client.Do()` call via `safeClient` to `requestPayload.URL` -- a URL configured by the user when creating a webhook.
- `PostAsync()` (line 184) enqueues the payload into `asyncPostQueue`, which is consumed by 4 goroutines that each call `Post()`.
- SSRF protection: `safeDialContext` (line 59) resolves the hostname and blocks reserved/private IP ranges via `isReservedIP`.
- URL validation at creation time: `ValidateURL()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go` (line 62).

#### 2. Link Metadata Fetching (HTTP GET to user-provided URLs)
- **Convergence point**: `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go` (line 136)
- Makes an HTTP GET to a URL provided in the RPC request to fetch HTML metadata (title, description, OG image).
- Uses a custom `httpClient` with `secureDialContext` that blocks internal/private IPs and validates redirect targets.

#### 3. OAuth2 SSO (HTTP requests to admin-configured Identity Provider endpoints)
- **Convergence point**: `oauth2.IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken()` (line 47) and `oauth2.IdentityProvider.UserInfo()` (line 83) in `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`
- `ExchangeToken` calls `conf.Exchange()` which makes an HTTP POST to `config.TokenUrl` (admin-configured OAuth2 token endpoint).
- `UserInfo` makes an HTTP GET to `config.UserInfoUrl` (admin-configured OAuth2 user info endpoint).
- These URLs come from the stored `IdentityProvider` configuration, set by an admin via `CreateIdentityProvider`/`UpdateIdentityProvider`.

#### 4. AI Transcription (HTTP requests to admin-configured AI API endpoints)
- **Convergence point (OpenAI)**: `openaisdk.Client.Audio.Transcriptions.New()` called from `Transcriber.Transcribe()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/stt/openai/openai.go` (line 71). Sends requests to a configurable `Endpoint` (defaults to `https://api.openai.com/v1`).
- **Convergence point (Gemini)**: `genai.Client.Models.GenerateContent()` called from `Model.GenerateFromAudio()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/audiollm/gemini/gemini.go` (line 120). Sends requests to a configurable endpoint (defaults to `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta`).
- The endpoint is admin-configured in the instance AI setting (`ProviderConfig.Endpoint`).

#### 5. SMTP Email (TCP connection to admin-configured SMTP server)
- **Convergence point**: `email.Client.Send()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/email/client.go` (line 51). Makes a TCP/TLS connection to the admin-configured SMTP host:port.
- While this is SMTP, not HTTP, it is an outbound network connection to a user-configured address.
- Called synchronously via `email.Send()` and asynchronously via `email.SendAsync()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/email/email.go`.

#### 6. S3 Storage (HTTP requests to admin-configured S3 endpoints)
- **Convergence point**: `s3.Client` operations in `/bench/home/work/internal/storage/s3/s3.go`. The `s3Config.Endpoint` is admin-configured.
- `UploadObject`, `PresignGetObject`, `GetObject` all make HTTP requests to the configured S3 endpoint.

---

### RPC Handlers That Transitively Trigger Outbound Requests

#### A. Via Webhook Dispatch (user-configured webhook URL)

These RPC handlers transitively call `webhook.PostAsync()`, which calls `webhook.Post()`, which makes an HTTP POST to the user's configured webhook URL:

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Dispatch Function Called | Activity Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`CreateMemo`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 157) | `memos.memo.created` |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (line 513) | `memos.memo.updated` |
| **`DeleteMemo`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (line 562) | `memos.memo.deleted` |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` | Two paths: (1) calls `CreateMemo` internally which calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 157 of memo_service.go); (2) calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 119) | `memos.memo.created` + `memos.memo.comment.created` |
| **`SetMemoRelations`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48) | `memos.memo.updated` |
| **`SetMemoAttachments`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48) | `memos.memo.updated` |

**Call chain**: RPC Handler -> `DispatchMemo*Webhook` / `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`) -> `s.Store.GetUserWebhooks()` -> for each webhook: `webhook.PostAsync()` -> `webhook.Post()` -> `safeClient.Do(req)` -> HTTP POST to `hook.Url`.

#### B. Via Link Metadata Fetching (URL provided in RPC request)

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Function Called |
|---|---|---|
| **`GetLinkMetadata`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go:14` | `getLinkMetadata` -> `fetchHTMLMeta` (= `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta`) |
| **`BatchGetLinkMetadata`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go:19` | `getLinkMetadata` -> `fetchHTMLMeta` for each URL |

**Call chain**: RPC Handler -> `getLinkMetadata()` (line 41) -> `fetchHTMLMeta(url)` (line 46) -> `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()` (html_meta.go:136) -> `httpClient.Get(urlStr)` -> HTTP GET to the user-provided URL.

#### C. Via OAuth2 SSO (admin-configured IDP endpoints)

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Function Called |
|---|---|---|
| **`SignIn`** (with SSO credentials) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go:51` | `resolveSSOIdentity` (line 80) |
| **`CreateLinkedIdentity`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_identities.go:39` | `resolveSSOIdentity` (line 56) |

**Call chain**: RPC Handler -> `resolveSSOIdentity()` (auth_service_sso.go:104) -> `oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken()` (line 126) -> HTTP POST to `config.TokenUrl` + `oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo()` (line 130) -> HTTP GET to `config.UserInfoUrl`.

#### D. Via AI Transcription (admin-configured AI API endpoints)

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Function Called |
|---|---|---|
| **`Transcribe`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/ai_service.go:48` | `transcribeViaSTT` or `transcribeViaAudioLLM` (lines 110-116) |

**Call chain (OpenAI path)**: `Transcribe` -> `transcribeViaSTT()` -> `sttopenai.New(provider, ...)` -> `Transcriber.Transcribe()` -> OpenAI SDK HTTP call to `provider.Endpoint + /audio/transcriptions`.

**Call chain (Gemini path)**: `Transcribe` -> `transcribeViaAudioLLM()` -> `audiollmgemini.New(provider, ...)` -> `Model.GenerateFromAudio()` -> Gemini SDK HTTP call to `provider.Endpoint`.

#### E. Via SMTP Email (admin-configured SMTP server)

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Function Called | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`TestInstanceEmailSetting`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go:256` | `notification.SendTestEmail()` (line 285) | Synchronous |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` | `createInboxWithEmailNotification()` (line 101) | Async, on comment creation |
| **`CreateMemo`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` | `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort()` -> `createInboxWithEmailNotification()` (line 172) | Async, on @mention |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` | `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort()` -> `createInboxWithEmailNotification()` (line 511) | Async, on new @mention in updated content |

**Call chain**: RPC Handler -> `createInboxWithEmailNotification()` (notification_email.go:11) -> `dispatchInboxEmailNotificationBestEffort()` (line 20) -> `notification.EmailDispatcher.DispatchInboxEmail()` (email.go:40) -> `email.SendAsync()` (email.go:55) -> `email.Send()` -> `Client.Send()` -> SMTP TCP connection to `config.SMTPHost:config.SMTPPort`.

#### F. Via S3 Storage (admin-configured S3 endpoint)

| RPC Handler | File:Line | Function Called |
|---|---|---|
| **`CreateAttachment`** | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:55` | `SaveAttachmentBlob()` -> `s3Client.UploadObject()` + `s3Client.PresignGetObject()` |
| **`GetAttachment`** (blob retrieval) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_storage.go:133` | `GetAttachmentBlob()` -> `s3Client.GetObject()` |

---

### Summary of Convergence Points

The key convergence points where outbound requests are actually dispatched:

1. **`webhook.Post()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` -- HTTP POST to user-configured webhook URL
2. **`httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go:136` -- HTTP GET to user-provided URL
3. **`oauth2.IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:47` -- HTTP POST to admin-configured token URL
4. **`oauth2.IdentityProvider.UserInfo()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:83` -- HTTP GET to admin-configured user info URL
5. **`sttopenai.Transcriber.Transcribe()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/stt/openai/openai.go:46` -- HTTP POST to admin-configured OpenAI endpoint
6. **`audiollmgemini.Model.GenerateFromAudio()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/audiollm/gemini/gemini.go:76` -- HTTP POST to admin-configured Gemini endpoint
7. **`email.Client.Send()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/email/client.go:51` -- SMTP TCP to admin-configured SMTP server
8. **`s3.Client` operations** at `/bench/home/work/internal/storage/s3/s3.go` -- HTTP to admin-configured S3 endpoint

Note: `httpgetter.GetImage()` at `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/image.go:16` exists and makes HTTP GET requests but is **not called from any RPC handler** -- it is an unused/dead code path.
